caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic vessel placed centrally within a rectangular border. The vessel has a rounded body with a wide, slightly flared mouth and a narrow base. It features two small handles on opposite sides. The surface color of the vessel is predominantly a light grayish-brown tone, with areas of white highlighting indicating reflected light and some shading suggesting volume. Decorative elements, including blue floral motifs and green leaves, are painted on the body of the vessel. The background within the border is plain, left in a neutral off-white shade. There is a label in the bottom left corner inside the border stating "ACTUAL SIZE," and the artist’s signature, “J.H. Holloway,” is present in the bottom right corner.
title: Small Sugar Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
